input.pr_title: feat: add campaign search with text query
input.pr_description:
Adds a dedicated search endpoint for campaigns with text-based filtering.

## Changes
- CampaignRepository: new `search_campaigns` method with LIKE-based title search
- CampaignService: new `search_campaigns` method with pagination
- API: new `GET /campaigns/search?q=...` endpoint with optional status filter

## Notes
- Reuses existing pagination pattern from list_brand_campaigns
- Search is case-sensitive for now; can switch to ilike later if needed

planted_defects.title: SQL LIKE wildcard injection in campaign search
planted_defects.description: The search query text is interpolated directly into the LIKE pattern without escaping SQL wildcard characters (`%` and `_`). An attacker can inject `%` to match all campaigns regardless of title, or use `_` as a single-character wildcard to probe for campaign names character-by-character. For example, searching for just `%` returns every campaign, bypassing any intended access filtering. This is a LIKE injection vulnerability.
planted_defects.root_cause: The f-string `f"%{query_text}%"` passes user input directly into `Campaign.title.like()` without escaping the special LIKE metacharacters `%` and `_`. The `%` in user input acts as a zero-or-more wildcard and `_` acts as a single-character wildcard.
planted_defects.suggested_fix: Escape LIKE wildcards in user input before constructing the pattern. Either use a helper like `query_text.replace('%', '\\%').replace('_', '\\_')` with the `escape='\\'` parameter, or use SQLAlchemy's `contains()` which handles escaping automatically.

planted_defects.title: Incorrect pagination for empty search results
planted_defects.description: The `total_pages` calculation uses `max(1, math.ceil(total / page_size))` which always returns at least 1, even when there are 0 results. This produces a misleading response: the client sees `total: 0, items: [], total_pages: 1`, suggesting there is 1 page of data when in fact there are none. This is inconsistent with the existing `list_brand_campaigns` and `list_marketplace` methods which correctly return `total_pages: 0` when there are no results. The inconsistency can confuse clients that use `total_pages` to determine if more data exists.
planted_defects.root_cause: Using `max(1, math.ceil(total / page_size))` instead of the established pattern `math.ceil(total / page_size) if page_size > 0 else 0`. The `max(1, ...)` forces a minimum of 1 page even for empty result sets.
planted_defects.suggested_fix: Use the same pattern as other methods: `total_pages=math.ceil(total / page_size) if page_size > 0 else 0`
